## OPS - Capacity Ranker Campaign Watchdog

Every 5 minutes, 08:00–21:00 ET, Mon–Sat: GET LP-MCP `/n8n/capacity-ranker/campaign-state` and alert GroupMe if either Data campaign (`Data - Hot Leads less than 7`, `Data - Warm Leads less than 30`) is NOT RUNNING, or the check itself fails.

**Why:** the capacity ranker (CAPACITY_RANKER_CYCLE_CAMPAIGNS) stops → reorders → restarts each Data campaign. Its `finally` block guarantees the restart at the process level but cannot cover a crash between stop and start. This watchdog is that cover. **Do not enable the cycle flag on LP-MCP until this workflow is ACTIVE.**

**Setup:**
1. `GROUPME_BOT_ID` must be set on the n8n main instance env (Railway) — the same OPS bot the other alerts use.
2. Activate. Confirm it posts nothing during a healthy hour.

**Repeat suppression:** the same campaign (or a failed check) is not re-alerted more than once per 30 minutes (workflow static data). A healthy read clears the suppression so the next outage alerts immediately.
